verdict.rationale: A third-party dataset marketplace is a fair question for a managed analytical database, so the axis applies. The pack shows only cross-cluster read-only data sharing and s3()/url() ingestion functions. Those are an adjacent sharing feature and developer building blocks, not a marketplace of third-party datasets for in-platform enrichment.

support.subject: As an analyst, a marketplace of third-party datasets lets me enrich my own data directly inside the platform
